wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap castle perimeter and separately mapped lodging, towers and chapel footprints. Two exact Qualla exterior photographs document the Loire and inland elevations.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the château ranges, chapel spire, paired ramp towers and terrace walls.
limitations: Roof and chapel heights use the scale of the documented surviving wings. Terrace masonry, fine sculpture and less visible roof details are simplified. The original DEM preserves the bluff and terrace but averages narrow vertical edges.
